summary: Wittgensteinian fideism (#1010) recorded in three variants from the pinned SEP entries Fideism §2.2.4 and Religious Language §§1, 4.1, 4.2: WF-N (critics' four theses), WF-P1 (early Phillips: religious belief expresses a moral vision, and praise does not refer to some object called God; the broader thesis that 'God' names no being is the unattributed STMT-GOD-NAMES-NO-BEING-WF-P1), WF-P2 (late Phillips and minimalism: reference and truth constituted inside the game, outside evidence admissible). Phillips, Winch and Nielsen themselves are in copyright with no hosted copy; bibliographic identities only, no claim read from them. Defeat by consequence of WF-N as a description of the Catholic practice: with Dei Filius can. II.1 (stated), the open bridge that conciliar definitions are the practice's own standards, and the open shared-reason reading of 'naturali humanae rationis lumine', the fideist pair is inconsistent (WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE); each premise is needed and the bundle alone is consistent (WF-CONSISTENT). Rejected: treating the defeat as a refutation of fideism in general, or of Phillips's 'not generally' thesis, which allows natural knowability; treating Nielsen's insulation charge as a defeat (it judges a consequence unacceptable, #1007). The self-application objection (the fideist thesis is a claim about religion's grammar made outside the game) is recorded as unresolved: thesis (3) restricts understanding, not correct philosophical claims about religion, and STMT-SELF-APPLICATION-DILEMMA would need a norm whose scope includes claims about a practice's grammar, an understanding-to-correctness bridge and a premise that the fideist claim fails the norm's standard, none of which is recorded. Bounded #1073 reference test: pinned Mathlib already proves structural invariance of full first-order sentence truth (StrongHomClass.realize_sentence); compose it with a Boolean swap and transported name/predicate. Every sentence and selected-interpretation inference agrees while literal referents differ. A fixed singleton anchor distinguishes the interpretations; the existing Russell Description.checks uniqueness direction forces agreement if both satisfy one fixed definite description. Rejected: reading this as nonreference, meaninglessness, a defeat of structuralism (which identifies permuted interpretations), or a proof that religious language has an independently applicable anchor. CorrectionCriterion and InterpretationRegress do not already supply the reference semantics. Bounded #1090 non-proof classification registers four distinct OPEN analyst positions: use-sensitive meaning, activity-specific linguistic practices, feature-vocabulary-relative family resemblance, and practical background of competence. Attribution is DEFERRED, not a new Wittgenstein source reading. None follows from the existing Fideism.Practice/regress/criterion/reference certificates; those are reused as exact boundary evidence. Meaning use is a methodological challenge to the nominal-reference dictionary, not a God-name nonreference conclusion; language games do not imply sharp cut-off; resemblance for some classifications does not establish universal anti-essentialism; practical background challenges a verbal-interpretation-alone competence basis, not F5 occurrence. Stronger existing fideist records remain separate. Strongest modest practice-sensitive realist, structuralist, common-feature/disjunctive-essence and elementary-reanalysis rivals are retained. PR1089 is delivered as7543687cae8fa152b529c3f076fbed622cd0ffc1: ATOMISM-INDEPENDENCE-CERTIFICATE is a selected-fragment atomism boundary, not historical coverage or whole-world representation. No new Lean/result/argument/inference/source/claim, no self-evidence marking or root relation; exact classifications and evidence map persist in docs/wittgenstein.md. Revelation definition audit (2026-11-06): the root capability and actual-practice CutOff were independent predicates whose alternative relation kept its required meaning map only in prose. RecognitionProfile now distinguishes candidate situations, an admitted subset, actual situation, recognition moves, correctness and outsider-shared reason. One-way realization is weaker than full capacity calibration; candidate realization and admitted-subset coverage explicitly split its scope. A checked coverage theorem supplies a precise outside-admitted correct-recognition witness when coverage fails. Raw actual CutOff with persistence, candidate realization, admitted coverage, shared recognition and an actual God witness yields the exact negation of the unchanged root capability. The existing alternative relation now uses that negation as subject, preserving raw CutOff as an explicit premise and serious rival. Six schema controls witness actual cut-off with capability via a nonactual situation, the realization/sharedness/God-witness gaps, strict calibration, and the outside-admitted escape. The original pair-defeat remains unchanged and is not promoted to a refutation of CutOff. No actual recognition, exhaustive real-possibility domain, author claim, independently true framework input or root closure is established. Declaration completion (2026-11-09): RECOGNIZABLE_REVELATION_2 now binds ActualPracticeRecognition σ R g m, the conjunction of existing RecognizesAsDivine at R.actual and grammatical Correct on that same move. No Godhood or admissibility filter is added. Parameterized Boolean controls over arbitrary original σ and g witness possible uptake without actual uptake, recognition without correctness, correctness without recognition, neither, and both. actualRecognitionPossible needs ActualAdmissible explicitly; actualRecognitionNotShared uses actual CutOffReading explicitly. These are conditional library controls, not new corpus establishment. No source interpretation is changed.
blocker: The original pair defeat still needs its three premises independently established; it does not refute raw CutOff alone. The new exact capability-negation route has additional open candidate-realization, admitted-coverage, shared-recognition and persistence premises plus God existence. Its selected candidate carrier is not claimed to exhaust real possibilities. Raw actual CutOff can survive by allowing correct shared recognition in another admitted situation; coverage can fail through the explicit outside-admitted witness. These are conditional configuration findings, not independent defense or counted root closure. The early-Phillips practice-reference rival remains unrefuted (the typed NamingPractice relation now exists, but its nominal-profile transfer and matching descriptor witnesses remain separate). The #1073 anchor applicability, four #1090 analyst positions and historical/full-scope #1010 acceptance remain open.
